regions.today: A mix of cloud and sunny spells with patchy light rain and drizzle. Moderate westerly winds.
regions.tonight: Tonight will be cloudy with patchy light rain and drizzle. Some mist and hill fog will develop also. Lowest temperatures of 13 to 15 degrees in moderate westerly winds.
regions.tomorrow: A cloudy start tomorrow with patchy light rain or drizzle and mist lingering at first. It will brighten up near east and southeast coasts through the afternoon with sunny spells slowly developing. Remaining dull elsewhere. Highest temperatures of 17 to 21 degrees in moderate westerly winds.
